segments.text: The goal is the manpage5 password, from /manpage/manpage4: a patched Wumpus game where the winner log prints the time, a first name, and a last name that are uninitialised on some paths.
The solve is a fixed seed and a stack overflow.
I log in as manpage four.
I read the diff to see the patch.
I pick seed one two three four five, which replicates the host libc rand: the layout is player at room eighteen, wumpus at thirteen, pits at two and sixteen, bats at five and three.
I shoot the wumpus, and the ROOM number line persists in getnum's stack buffer, overlapping the name buffers.
That makes the print go into a buffer I control: a NOP sled, then a setresuid shellcode for seventeen thousand five, and the return address into the sled.
id confirms uid seventeen thousand five, manpage five.
And the password file reads back the manpage5 password.
